display.summary: The audit/soft-delete switches can be turned off again, and a plain Save no longer behaves as "save and add more".
highlights: Record Visibility switches now save from the step they render in — they could be turned on and never off.
A plain modal Save no longer reopens the form: add-more is decided by the field's value, not its presence.
Both were reproduced against a live deployment before and after the fix.
